entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans, the largest and most fearsome, a conscious and self-aware being that twists living things.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan imprisoned on Zendikar and later killed.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan imprisoned on Zendikar and later killed.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The Zendikari merfolk god inspired by Emrakul and the figment through which she spoke to Jace.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped trap the Eldrazi and inscribed hedrons with runes.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who built the hedron network on Zendikar and later summoned Emrakul to Innistrad for revenge on Sorin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi and unmade Avacyn.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who released the Eldrazi on Zendikar and was part of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel who kept Emrakul at bay on Innistrad until Sorin unmade her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who communicated with Emrakul's figment and later created the Echoverse.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A member of the Gatewatch who fought Emrakul.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A member of the Gatewatch who fought Emrakul.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker nearly brought down by Emrakul's mental assaults.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A scholar possessed by Emrakul and forced to read a scroll that trapped her in Innistrad's moon.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A creation of Jace who contacts Emrakul and later guides her to consume the Echoverse.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A band of planeswalkers who fought the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane where the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Emrakul corrupted people and was trapped in the moon.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The heart of the Zendikar hedron trap where the three planeswalkers sealed the Titans.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: An alternate multiverse of unstable planes that Emrakul consumed.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Emrakul traveled.

events.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise and build a hedron and leyline network on Zendikar to trap the Eldrazi.
events.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

events.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
events.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

events.summary: The three planeswalkers combine their magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedron network, sealing the Titans in stone.
events.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

events.summary: After Nissa releases the Titans, Emrakul vanishes and is drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, who wants revenge on Sorin.
events.quote: She was drawn through the Blind Eternities to the plane of Innistrad by the planeswalker Nahiri

events.summary: Avacyn holds Emrakul at bay until Sorin unmakes her, and then Emrakul enters Innistrad physically.
events.quote: once she was unmade by Sorin, the titan physically entered Innistrad

events.summary: The Gatewatch and Liliana confront Emrakul at Thraben; Jace speaks with her figment Emeria.
events.quote: Emrakul was confronted by the Gatewatch and Liliana Vess

events.summary: Emrakul possesses Tamiyo and forces her to read a scroll, voluntarily trapping herself in Innistrad's moon.
events.quote: She possessed Tamiyo and forced her to read a scroll she had vowed to never read, voluntarily trapping herself in Innistrad's moon .

events.summary: Tam contacts Emrakul in the moon and Emrakul learns of the Echoverse; Tam severs the link when Emrakul demands to destroy it.
events.quote: Emrakul demanded that Tam guide her to the Echoverse so she could destroy it, which frightened Tam into severing their psychic connection.

events.summary: Tam receives Jace's spark, reaches out to Emrakul and tells her of the unnatural Multiverse to be consumed.
events.quote: telling her that there was an unnatural Multiverse that needed to be consumed.

events.summary: Emrakul separates the Multiverse from the Echoverse and consumes the Echoverse.
events.quote: dematerialized the latter, pulling it into herself and consuming it.

relations.note: The Gatewatch fought and ritually banished her.
relations.quote: Emrakul was confronted by the Gatewatch and Liliana Vess

relations.note: They built the Zendikar trap together.
relations.quote: Ugin , Nahiri , and Sorin Markov prepared thoroughly to trap them on Nahiri's home plane of Zendikar .

relations.note: Tam guided Emrakul to the Echoverse.
relations.quote: Expressing her thanks to Tam, she demarcated the two

relations.note: Emeria is a god inspired by Emrakul.
relations.quote: the inspiration for the Zendikari merfolk god Emeria

relations.note: Nissa released the Titans, including Emrakul.
relations.quote: After the release of Kozilek , Ulamog , and Emrakul by Nissa Revane , Emrakul vanished.
